name: RAPID Līmes pistole EG PEN, 7mm, ar statīvu
desc: Ideal for use around the home as well as in arts and crafts projects, this versatile pen-shaped glue gun offers better grip and a long trigger for smoother, more precise gluing and more control when working on tricky or detailed parts. It heats up in just 60 seconds and is supplied with a stable stand for practical, safe and sticky-free storage between periods of use. Designed for use with our 7 mm transparent and coloured glue stick range, making it perfect for many applications.
Pen shape for higher precision and best grip
Practical stand with silicon drip tray included
